definitions.explanation: A gathering at which tea is served in the tea ceremony, or the room or seat where the ceremony takes place. Often used for the occasion as a whole.

examples.japanese: {茶席|ちゃせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}かれた→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: I was invited to a tea gathering.

examples.japanese: {茶席|ちゃせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧。
examples.english: One behaves quietly at a tea gathering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{茶道部|さどうぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{茶席|ちゃせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}けた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: The tea ceremony club set up a tea gathering at the school festival.

notes:
Refers both to the tea gathering itself and to the physical space (room or seat) where tea is served. Common in the context of ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (the way of tea).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶席|ちゃせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to hold a tea gathering
- {茶席|ちゃせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧: to invite to a tea gathering
- {茶席|ちゃせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to attend a tea gathering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茶会|ちゃかい}→茶会：14116_chakai⟧: tea party; tea gathering — emphasizes the event and its guests
- ⟦{茶室|ちゃしつ}→茶室：14081_chashitsu⟧: tea room — the dedicated room itself
